consumer: An engine possession/eligibility check (the crafting/condition path that calls Character::has_amount/amount_of) asking 'does the avatar possess at least one working multitool?'
scope: only the character's own carried items (wielded + worn + on-person inventory), including pseudo/bionic tool semantics; not items reachable nearby
decisive_source: src/visitable.cpp::visitable<Character>::amount_of — the engine-COMPUTED possession predicate that special-cases BIONIC_TOOLS pseudo-tools and otherwise tallies via amount_of_internal; its return value is the authoritative yes/no, not a re-derivation from the snapshot
divergence: Avatar has an active bionic that fakes a multitool (or holds a multitool nested inside a gun/magazine excluded by visit_internal's gun/magazine guard): amount_of returns >=1 while the carried_items[] snapshot disagrees, exposing a wrong answer derived from the snapshot instead of the engine predicate
